comments.author: Michael Giver
comments.body:
Progress 2026-07-29: Phase C committed as b411fb54 on giverm/OSCER-805-non-exclusion-orchestrator-wiring (unpushed, no PR yet). Built: trailing verification_data_source_check step + DataSourceCheckService; Determination::CALCULATION_TYPE_DATA_SOURCE_CE + CertificationCase#record_data_source_ce_determination for source-attested CE; negative determination relocated to the trailing step, routed via a new listener-less DeterminedCommunityEngagementNotMet; MockCommunityEngagement (order 20); runtime enforcement of declared_outcomes in Verification::DataSource#call.

Naming deviation from the plan doc: the step is verification_data_source_check (not external_non_exclusion_check) and the service is DataSourceCheckService (not NonExclusionDeterminationService). 'External' in this codebase means data pushed INTO OSCER; this step is where OSCER calls OUT.

AC deviations, both accepted: (1) the FEATURE_MOCK_DATA_SOURCES flag in the AC was dropped, superseded by PR #807's config-registration convention (already recorded 2026-07-28); (2) the AC says the CE check 'routes not-met members into the orchestrator' via existing events, but that had to become a NEW listener-less internal event. NotificationsEventListener binds handlers to event NAMES with no step awareness, so reusing a member-facing negative event would have emailed the member before sources were consulted, then a second contradictory email if a source excepted them.

RUNTIME WALKTHROUGH FINDING (2026-07-29): drove the real cascade in dev and found MockCommunityEngagement could never fire in the shipped config, so the source-attested CE determination path had never executed end to end. mock_drug_treatment (PR #807) is consulted at the earlier exclusion step and terminates the case for 7 of 10 va_icn last digits (0/3/6/9 excluded; 1/5/7 excepted via was_in_drug_treatment), leaving only 2/4/8 to reach the orchestrator, all even, which is mock_emergency_county's branch under stop-on-first. No spec could catch it: each adapter spec asserts its own rule in isolation and each was correct, certification_business_process_spec stubs DataSourceCheckService outright, and the orchestrator's real-registry cases start from a Certification so they skip ExclusionDeterminationService. The failure existed only in the composition of two stages.

Fixed by re-keying MockCommunityEngagement off the member email (TRIGGER_EMAIL_SUBSTRING = 'ce-met', case-insensitive) rather than re-partitioning the va_icn keyspace. No determination path reads email (verified by grep), so the source is orthogonal to every va_icn-keyed source present or future; the substring idiom follows Auth::MockAdapter. Zero edits to already-merged mocks; order 20 unchanged. Added spec/business_processes/certification_business_process_reachability_spec.rb, which drives the real cascade with nothing in the determination path stubbed and asserts over the live registry that every enabled order-bearing source is creditable.

Verification: full suite 3161 examples / 0 failures, 96.76% line and 84.24% branch, RuboCop clean across 573 files, and all 10 documented paths re-verified at runtime against the shipped config with exactly one determination each. Plan doc revised to as-built: Tech Specs/OSCER/non-exclusion-orchestrator-buildout-plan.md.

Remaining: commit the fix, /review the branch, then push + open PR (base main, 'Part of #805').

comments.author: Michael Giver
comments.body:
Review 2026-07-29 (/review, 3 parallel agents vs base main, 3 commits): PASS at minimum score 4. Security (Opus): vulnerability 5, authorization 4, input_validation 4, output_sanitization 5. Quality (Sonnet): maintainability 4, test_coverage 5, rails_conventions 5, reliability 4. Context (Haiku): requirement_alignment 5, scope_appropriateness 5, epic_coherence 5 (both AC deviations judged reasonable and adequately documented; the email re-key judged in scope as a repair of this branch's own deliverable).

Acted on three findings, all comment-only, committed as c9003b2e (suite unchanged at 3161 examples / 0 failures, RuboCop clean):
1. Over-broad #810 attribution. Verified directly: #810's AC reads 'On data source error in ExclusionDeterminationService, the service TBD', so it covers neither the trailing step nor propagated unexpected errors. Three sites cited it; now they name the residual gaps and say a separate ticket is needed.
2. 'Cannot diverge' overclaimed for the recomputed hours/income aggregates. The two reads are not one snapshot, so a concurrent write to the certification's activity data would change the totals. Softened; no code path introduces one today.
3. MockCommunityEngagement's email trigger is influenceable by the SUBJECT of the determination, unlike state-assigned va_icn, and email is also the key joining a signed-in user to their certification (DashboardController -> Certification.find_by_member_email). Recorded as a property a real source must never copy.

Declined two suggestions, with reasons: (a) extracting a shared hours/income compute helper across CommunityEngagementCheckService and DataSourceCheckService, since both already call the same underlying service methods and only the four-call sequence is duplicated, so the drift risk does not justify the abstraction; (b) stamping failed source ids into determination_data, which is real behavior work for a follow-up ticket rather than part of this branch.

THREE UNTICKETED GAPS surfaced, each latent today because every registered source is an in-memory mock that cannot raise, and each live with the first real adapter. Need tickets or an explicit widening of #810 before one lands:
- An errored source produces a member-facing not_compliant determination whose row is indistinguishable from a clean negative; the only evidence is a log line.
- An error outside a source's expected_error_classes propagates by design, but Strata::BusinessProcessInstance#execute_current_step is 'rescue Exception' + logger.error with no re-raise, so the case strands with no determination, no notification and no staff task. Newly consequential because this step took over the member's only notification.
- An order-bearing hybrid source (exclusion + non-exclusion outcomes) is permitted at boot but would raise UnsupportedOutcomeError and stall the case the same silent way. Durable fix is filtering hybrids in DataSourceOrchestrator#ordered_sources.
- Separately, the no-ExternalException.enabled?-gate gap has no tracking issue at all.

Branch state: 3 commits (b411fb54 wiring, 46c84c32 email re-key, c9003b2e comment corrections), unpushed, no PR yet.

PR OPENED 2026-07-29 as DRAFT: https://github.com/navapbc/oscer/pull/822 (Part of #805, base main). Five commits: b411fb54 wiring, 46c84c32 email re-key, c9003b2e comment corrections, ad7da507 shared assessment + spec helpers, ff257ffc comment trim. mergeable=MERGEABLE (no conflict with #821, which landed on main first); CI running at open.

PR body written independently of the commit messages and reframed on review feedback: the Context section describes where the work sits in epic #732 (contract #754, VA adapter #755, registry #756, exclusion-path consultation #808, provenance #811, ordering engine #812 which nothing consumed) rather than defending choices. The earlier draft read as a list of deviations, but most of those were just the expected design; the FEATURE_MOCK_DATA_SOURCES note and the determination-shape rationale were dropped for that reason.

NOT in the PR body, by decision: the three reviewer questions (exception-wins precedence when one source emits both outcome kinds; dashboard income-cards default for data_source_ce rows, hidden by income_summary_visible?'s allow-list; attempted retained unconsumed). All three are documented in code. Raise them as a PR comment or in #tss-oscer if they should be actively asked.

STILL OPEN: (1) do NOT let GitHub default the squash message to b411fb54 -- its body still describes the mock firing on an odd va_icn last digit, superseded by 46c84c32. (2) Four unticketed gaps need issues or #810 widened: errored source yields a member-facing not_compliant row indistinguishable from a clean negative; an error outside expected_error_classes is swallowed by Strata's rescue Exception and strands the case; an order-bearing hybrid source stalls the same way; and the missing ExternalException.enabled? gate has no ticket at all.

comments.author: Michael Giver
comments.body:
SPLIT into a two-PR stack 2026-07-29, after review feedback that the single PR was too large (25 files, +1624/-161; our guidance is 200-500 lines, 500 max).

- DRAFT PR #823 https://github.com/navapbc/oscer/pull/823 'Enforce the verification data source outcome contract', base main, branch giverm/OSCER-805-data-source-outcome-contract, commit cfd070cd. 6 files, +203/-6. Verification::DataSource#call runtime ContractError + Determination::EXCEPTION_OUTCOME_KEYS/CE_OUTCOME_KEYS + loader boot validation of the partition. Stands alone: suite 3053 ex / 0 fail, RuboCop clean (568 files). Independently valuable because it also hardens the exclusion path #808 already made live.
- DRAFT PR #822 https://github.com/navapbc/oscer/pull/822 retargeted onto #823's branch, force-pushed to commit 127ea5c1. 23 files, +1443/-177. The wiring: trailing verification_data_source_check step, negative relocation, MockCommunityEngagement, reachability guard, shared assess extraction, spec-helper dedup. Suite 3161 ex / 0 fail, RuboCop clean (576 files).

Split method: built the foundation branch off origin/main, pulled the six relevant files from the wiring branch, then removed forward references so the foundation is self-consistent (CALCULATION_TYPE_DATA_SOURCE_CE out of determination.rb, the hybrid-source gap note out of the loader since it describes a consumer that does not exist there yet, and the mock_community_engagement registration assertions out of the loader spec). Rebuilt the wiring on top and verified the combined tree is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-split branch for app/config/spec, so the split is lossless.

Both branches are on latest main (705d47e7, the #821 dependency bundle). NOTE: that bundle bumped csv/aws-sdk/simplecov/aws-partitions, so a local 'make build' is required before lint or specs will run on either branch; the pre-split branch predated it and did not need one.

Considered and DECLINED a third split (exception path + negative relocation, then CE attestation + mock). The seam is clean since data_source_check_service_spec is organised by context, but it yields ~970 + ~650 lines, so only one slice lands near target, and it needs surgery inside a service and a 501-line spec. The wiring PR's production diff is only ~280 lines across 9 files; the bulk is three new spec files a reviewer reads once. Michael's call: stop at two.

Review order for Jeff: #823 first, then #822. After #823 merges, #822's base changes to main.

compiled_state.description:
Mirror of GitHub issue #805 (https://github.com/navapbc/oscer/issues/805).

Build the orchestrator the Data Source registry (#756) was designed for but deferred. Per the Data Source Hierarchy spec (#732, "Add non-Exclusions to the Data Source Registry"): a new system_process after external_community_engagement_check that calls ordered non-exclusion sources, stops on the first positive result, and takes over the negative-determination + report_activities handoff from the community-engagement check.

No real non-exclusion source exists yet, so this is orchestrator-only, proven against a mock source behind a feature flag (off in production, so behavior is unchanged).

## Acceptance Criteria
- New system_process after external_community_engagement_check; iterates enabled sources with an order (ascending), stops on first :success. order: nil sources are skipped.
- Records the producing source id for the API outcome; :skipped/:error do not stop the pass.
- Owns the negative-determination + report_activities trigger when no source succeeds; the community-engagement check routes not-met members into the orchestrator.
- Mock Verification::DataSource registered only when FEATURE_MOCK_DATA_SOURCES is on; add that flag to Features::FEATURE_FLAGS (default false).
- Automated tests via mock adapters: ordering, stop-on-success, skip/error, empty-set, provenance.

## Out-of-scope
- Exclusion ranking (Exclusion.priority_order).
- Migrating existing exception/CE determinations into registered adapters.
- Hybrid (exclusion + non-exclusion) sources.

## Coordination
- Merge order vs #767 (same business process, also adds mock sources); consider a shared FEATURE_MOCK_DATA_SOURCES flag.

## Links
- Epic #732; registry #755/#756; related #767/#768
